sources.title: Recommendations for safe use of medicines terminology

sources.limitations: PDF text inspected; source-PDF image rendering failed in this environment. Not an exhaustive safe list. CC BY-NC-ND notice: link to the original, do not republish the full tables or present a modified table as official.

sources.title: Ambulance attendances for suicidality and self-harm
sources.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare

sources.title: National Outcomes and Casemix Collection NBEDS 2026-27
sources.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare
sources.locatorAndScope: Scope, collection period and outcome-measure specifications. NOCC dataset naming and listed outcome-measure names/settings.
sources.limitations: The broad NBEDS is not the mandatory NMDS subset. Instrument selection depends on age, setting and collection occasion. Dataset year is not instrument version. Do not turn a data-collection rule into a clinical diagnostic threshold.

sources.title: National Outcomes and Casemix Collection NMDS 2026-27
sources.publisher: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare

sources.limitations: Do not assume every NBEDS element is a universally mandatory NMDS item. Check the exact year, setting and collection occasion.

sources.title: Suicide and self-harm monitoring glossary
